findings.summary: Delivery status, the column people come for, is light grey (#9aa1ab) on white, about 2.6:1.
findings.fix: Show status in words on its status token pair.

findings.summary: The search field's only label is its placeholder, which disappears on typing; the filter button is an icon with no name, so a screen reader says only "button".
findings.fix: A visible label for search; an accessible name for the filter button.

findings.summary: The Track buttons are 32 px tall (compact size) on a page used on phones.
Three buttons are all named "Track"; out of context a screen-reader user cannot tell which order each tracks.
findings.fix: Name each button with its order, at least for assistive technology.

findings.summary: Elements must meet minimum color contrast ratio thresholds (serious, 3 node(s))
Buttons must have discernible text (critical, 1 node(s))
target smaller than the floor: Track (57x32)
findings.fix: make the control at least the [verify.floors.a11y] min_target_px square
